name: development-claude-plugin
description: Plugin family for projects that ARE Claude Code plugins. Ships a test harness (/development-claude-plugin:test) and a maintenance dispatcher (a topic plugin: composes alongside the language plugin via /development:maintenance). Validators: version sync (claude-plugin-version-sync), SKILL.md/agent frontmatter (claude-plugin-skill-validator), and orphaned skill/agent references (claude-plugin-reference-checker). Directory-structure validation follows.
